data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for native iOS interactively dismissible keyboard.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets like CupertinoInteractiveKeyboard and CupertinoInputAccessory to enable native iOS interactive keyboard dismissal and input accessory view behavior in Flutter applications. It avoids questionable keyboard screenshot approaches for more solid performance.
use_when: You are building an iOS app with Flutter and need native interactively dismissible keyboards
You have chat-like UIs requiring an input bar attached to the bottom matching native input accessory view size
avoid_when: You are targeting Android or non-iOS platforms where this native iOS behavior is not applicable
You prefer not to use platform-specific plugins for keyboard handling
strengths: Achieves native iOS interactively dismissible keyboard behavior
Does not rely on questionable keyboard screenshot approaches
Includes route awareness and interactive keyboard scroll physics
weaknesses: Limited to iOS platform support as a native feature wrapper
Acts as a temporary solution for specific open Flutter framework issues
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml and use the provided CupertinoInteractiveKeyboard and CupertinoInputAccessory widgets in your widget tree.
